name: Idiopathic Mesenteric Phlebosclerosis
aliases: Chronic Ischemic Colitis due to Mesenteric Venous Sclerosis

criteria.description: Radiologic evidence of mesenteric venous calcification on CT imaging
Colonic wall thickening predominantly in the right colon on imaging
Histopathological confirmation of sclerosis and fibrosis of mesenteric veins
Chronic gastrointestinal symptoms consistent with ischemic colitis

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of radiologic venous calcification and colonic wall thickening plus histopathologic confirmation of mesenteric venous sclerosis
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is often confirmed by a combination of imaging and histopathology; exclusion of other causes of colitis is essential.

searchTerms: pain on right side of belly

pathognomonic.symptomName: Mesenteric venous calcification visible on imaging
searchTerms: calcified veins in abdomen on scan
hidden blood loss in digestive tract
sepsis due to bowel blood loss

laboratory: Mild anemia due to chronic blood loss
Elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ESR) in some cases
imaging: CT scan showing characteristic linear or serpentine calcifications along mesenteric veins
Colonic wall thickening predominantly in ascending colon
Venous phase imaging demonstrating venous sclerosis
other: Histopathology showing fibrosis and sclerosis of mesenteric veins with luminal narrowing

distinguishingFeatures: Usually arterial ischemia rather than venous sclerosis
Lack of mesenteric venous calcification on imaging
Presence of mucosal ulceration and inflammation without venous calcification
Younger age of onset and systemic autoimmune features
Acute presentation with venous occlusion rather than chronic sclerosis

redFlags: Severe abdominal pain with signs of peritonitis
Evidence of colonic perforation or sepsis
references: Chen YY, et al. Idiopathic mesenteric phlebosclerosis: a rare cause of chronic ischemic colitis. World J Gastroenterol. 2015;21(30):9266-9273.
Kusanagi H, et al. Mesenteric phlebosclerosis: a review of the literature. J Gastroenterol Hepatol. 2018;33(1):9-15.
Zhao Y, et al. Imaging features of idiopathic mesenteric phlebosclerosis. Abdom Radiol (NY). 2019;44(3):1024-1031.
